Visual defects against the UX brief (PR #1018)

  • Run detail drawer is translucent — Text of the page behind the drawer (filters, run row, "Pause all publication") shows through the drawer in the two themes. Cause: the drawer uses .surface-1, which is a glass reading plane, not an overlay. Component: review-run-detail.component.ts (it is on main; not new in PR #1040). Open. A test with data-glass-surface=overlay made the dark drawer opaque but broke the drawer layout in the light theme, so that edit was removed.
  • Drawer header is behind the navigation bar — The title "PR #428 review" and the Close button are below the top navigation bar. The drawer starts at the top of the window with z-50. The review settings drawer has the same structure. Open. Not fixed in this run.
  • Accept button stays gold after triage — On an accepted or dismissed card the Accept button keeps the primary color and only Dismiss looks inactive. The state text below the buttons is correct. Open. Not fixed in this run.
